description:
A wonderful opportunity to acquire a substantial detached family residence enjoying an enviable position on a mature and exceptionally private site along Leopardstown Road. Set behind mature hedging and approached via a generous, gravelled driveway providing ample off-street parking, Woodleigh offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation ideally suited to modern family living. The property has been lovingly maintained over the years and presents an exciting opportunity for purchasers to further modernise and personalise to their own requirements.

Extending to approximately 255 sq. m/ 2745 sq. ft the accommodation is both spacious and versatile. An inviting entrance hall gives access to a magnificent sitting room overlooking the rear garden, a comfortable family room to the front, a study ideal for home working and a formal dining room. To the rear lies a large kitchen/breakfast room with Aga and direct access to the patio and garden. A utility room, storeroom and guest w.c. complete the ground floor accommodation. 

Upstairs, there are four generous bedrooms together with a family bathroom. The principal suite is a particular feature, comprising an exceptionally spacious bedroom with extensive wardrobe space, a separate dressing room and ensuite bathroom. Originally laid out as two bedrooms, this area could easily be reinstated to provide a fifth bedroom should additional accommodation be required.

A particular feature of Woodleigh is its magnificent north-westerly facing rear garden. Wonderfully private and bordered by mature trees, specimen planting and established hedging, it provides a peaceful setting rarely found so close to an array of amenities. A large patio terrace enjoys sunshine throughout the afternoon and into the evening, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining.

Offering space, privacy and an excellent family-friendly layout in a highly convenient location, Woodleigh is sure to appeal to discerning purchasers seeking a forever home in one of South Dublin's most established residential settings.

Leopardstown Road is a highly regarded residential road of mature, quality family homes in the heart of Foxrock. The property is within walking distance of nearby Foxrock Village with its specialist shops and the popular Gables restaurant. There are numerous recreational amenities in the area to include nearby Foxrock golf club and Leopardstown racecourse. There is an excellent selection of shopping facilities nearby to include Carrickmines Retail Park, Cornelscourt shopping centre and Dundrum Town Centre is easily accessible. There are a range of highly sought after secondary schools within easy reach of Leopardstown Road. This is a first class residential location where houses of this calibre offering such potential rarely come to the market. The N11 QBC together with the Luas at Sandyford provide easy access to Dublin city centre. It is also easily accessible to nearby Sandyford Business Park and the M50 interchange providing access to all points north, south, east and west.
